metric_definitions.all_required_evidence: Fraction of answerable healthy queries retaining every locator in at least one gold alternative
metric_definitions.candidate_evidence_recall: Mean best-alternative gold locator coverage in all candidates
metric_definitions.document_mrr_at_5_chunks: Mean reciprocal first relevant document rank after top-5 chunk deduplication
metric_definitions.document_recall_at_5_chunks: Mean relevant-document coverage after top-5 chunks are deduplicated to documents; answerable healthy queries only
metric_definitions.evidence_accepted_without_answer_label: Fraction of unanswerable healthy queries returning any evidence; not final hallucination rate
metric_definitions.evidence_mrr_at_5: Mean reciprocal first matching gold locator rank in top-5 chunks
metric_definitions.evidence_recall_at_5: Mean best-alternative gold locator coverage in top-5 chunks
metric_definitions.false_refusal_proxy: Fraction of answerable healthy queries with no selected evidence; retrieval proxy only
metric_definitions.selected_evidence_coverage: Mean best-alternative required locator coverage after threshold/budget selection

provenance_note: Exact historical run commit is unknown unless recorded. Original source hashes/config/dataset are retained in referenced reports; do not substitute Phase10 HEAD for experiment commit.
unknown_policy: unknown is never zero; absent required denominator is an error
